prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Write package solution in solution.go with the function at package scope.
Required API: func RollingChecksums(values []int, window int) ([]int, bool)
Behavior: For every complete window, emit the position-weighted checksum sum((offset+1)*value). Reject a zero window (and negative where representable). A window longer than input returns a non-null empty result; do not mutate input.
Visible example: values [2,4,1,3] with window 3 return [13,15].

Buggy source to repair:

package solution
func RollingChecksums(values []int,window int)([]int,bool){if window<=0{return nil,false};out:=[]int{};for i:=0;i+window<=len(values);i++{sum:=0;for j:=i;j<i+window;j++{sum+=values[j]};out=append(out,sum)};return out,true}

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
package solution
func RollingChecksums(values []int,window int)([]int,bool){if window<=0{return nil,false};out:=[]int{};for i:=0;i+window<=len(values);i++{sum:=0;for j:=0;j<window;j++{sum+=(j+1)*values[i+j]};out=append(out,sum)};return out,true}
